blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Adapting multilingual speech foundation models to low-resource languages remains difficult, especially for languages that are poorly represented during pre-training.
While parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting large models, conventional approaches such as LoRA rely on generic low-rank parameterizations and do not explicitly use downstream task information to define the adaptation subspace. To investigate whether task-informed PEFT can better support low-resource ASR, we apply Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis (FCCA) to Whisper and Qwen3-ASR, and introduce two complementary extensions: Asymmetric-Coupled FCCA (AC-FCCA), which exploits structured cross-layer sharing, and Adaptive-Rank FCCA (AR-FCCA), which reallocates adaptation capacity across projection matrices under a fixed parameter budget. Under controlled multilingual experiments, we evaluate these approaches on languages that are poorly represented or unsupported during pre-training alongside well-represented languages. Standard FCCA is competitive with, and usually outperforms, trainable-parameter-budget-matched LoRA. AR-FCCA provides the most consistent improvement over standard FCCA across both model architectures, with statistically significant gains in several evaluation settings, while retaining the same number of trainable parameters. These results show that task-informed subspace construction can be effective for low-resource speech adaptation, and that adaptive rank allocation provides a robust way to improve parameter efficiency without increasing model capacity.
blocks.zh:
使多语种语音基础模式适应低资源语言仍然是困难的,特别是在培训前没有得到充分代表的语言。
虽然参数效率微调(PEFT)降低了大型模型的改造成本,但LORA等常规方法依赖于通用低级参数化,并且没有明确使用下游任务信息来定义适应子空间. 为了调查了解任务情况的PEFT是否能够更好地支持低资源ASR,我们将Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis(FCCA)应用于Whisper和Quen3-ASR,并引入两个互补的扩展:利用结构化跨层共享的Asmomic-Coupled FCCA(AC-FCCA)和根据固定参数预算对预测矩阵的适应能力进行重新分配的Adaptive-Rank FCCA(AR-FCCA). 在受控制的多语种实验下,我们评价这些方法涉及在预训期间代表不足或得不到支持的语言以及代表人数充足的语言。 标准FCCA与可训练参数-预算匹配的LORA具有竞争力,而且通常优于业绩. AR-FCCA在两个模型结构中都比标准FCCA提供了最一致的改进,在几个评价环境中取得了统计上的重大进展,同时保留了同样数量的可训练参数. 这些结果显示,基于任务知情的子空间构建对于低资源语音适应是有效的,适应性排位分配提供了在不增加模型能力的情况下提高参数效率的有力方式.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speech foundation models, such as Whisper [ 18 ] and Qwen3-ASR [ 19 ] , have substantially improved multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), allowing a single model to recognise dozens of languages. However, many languages remain underrepresented during pre-training, including low-resource, endangered and regional languages, for which only a few hours of labelled speech are available. Developing speech technologies for these languages benefits practical applications, linguistic research and language documentation [ 12 , 13 ] . In particular, speech technologies can accelerate the documentation, annotation, and analysis of endangered languages, providing scalable tools for phonetic, phonological, and sociolinguistic studies. Consequently, efficiently adapting speech foundation models with limited labelled data has become an important research problem for multilingual low-resource ASR.
blocks.zh: 语音基础模型,如Whisper [18] 和Qune3-ASR [19],大大改进了多语种自动语音识别(ASR),允许单一模型识别数十种语言. 然而,许多语言在培训前阶段仍然代表性不足,包括资源匮乏、濒危和区域语言,只有几个小时的有标签的演讲。 为这些语言开发语音技术有利于实际应用、语言研究和语言文献[12、13]。 特别是,语音技术可以加速对濒危语言的文献、注释和分析,为语音、录音和社会语言学研究提供可扩展的工具。 因此,有效调整带有有限标记数据的语音基础模型已成为多语种低资源ASR的一个重要研究问题。

blocks.en:
Full fine-tuning remains an effective adaptation strategy but requires updating all model parameters, resulting in substantial computational and memory costs. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) addresses this limitation by adapting only a small subset of parameters while maintaining competitive performance. Representative approaches include adapter tuning [ 5 , 16 ] , prefix tuning [ 11 ] , prompt tuning [ 8 ] , and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 6 ] , with LoRA becoming one of the dominant approaches for adapting speech foundation models.
Recent studies have further investigated continual language learning [ 17 ] and source language adaptation for low-resource ASR [ 3 ] . Recent PEFT methods have increasingly exploited downstream data to identify more informative adaptation directions [ 23 , 9 , 4 , 10 ] , for example through gradient-informed initialisation in LoRA-GA [ 22 ] and activation-based subspace selection and rank allocation in EVA [ 15 ] . Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis (FCCA) takes this further by deriving paired low-rank adaptation subspaces from Fisher-whitened input–error statistics [ 24 ] . This task-informed PEFT has shown promising results for large language models (LLMs), but its effectiveness for speech foundation models, particularly under low-resource adaptation, remains unexplored.
blocks.zh:
全面微调仍然是一个有效的适应战略,但需要更新所有模型参数,从而产生大量的计算和内存成本。 参数效率微调(PEFT)通过在保持竞争性能的同时仅调整一小部分参数来解决这一限制. 具有代表性的方法包括适配器调制[5,16],前缀调制[11],即时调制[8],低调调调制(Lora)[6],LORA成为适应语音基础模型的主要方法之一.
最近的研究进一步调查了持续语言学习[17]和低资源ASR的来源语言适应性[3]. 近期的PEFT方法越来越多地利用下游数据,以确定更多的信息化适应方向[23、9、4、10],例如,通过在LORA-GA[22]中梯度知情初始化和在EVA中基于激活的子空间选择和等级分配[15]。 Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis(FCCA)通过从Fisher-Whitened输入-error统计中推导出对齐的低级适应子空间来进一步推进这项工作。 这个任务知情的PEFT对于大型语言模型(LLMS)显示出了有希望的结果,但其对于语音基础模型的有效性,特别是在资源低的适应下,仍然没有得到探讨.

blocks.en: This work investigates whether task-informed PEFT transfers effectively to multilingual low-resource ASR by adapting FCCA to speech foundation models. The original FCCA study focuses on decoder-only autoregressive LLMs (i.e. Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct [ 20 ] ), whereas speech models such as Whisper use an encoder–decoder architecture that must first learn representations from continuous acoustic input. These differences make it unclear whether the same task-informed subspace construction will behave similarly for speech recognition. Building upon FCCA, we propose two complementary approaches for improving task-informed adaptation. Asymmetric-Coupled FCCA (AC-FCCA) investigates whether structured cross-layer parameter sharing can improve adaptation efficiency, while Adaptive-Rank FCCA (AR-FCCA) redistributes adaptation capacity across projection matrices under a fixed parameter budget. These two approaches investigate different aspects of task-informed PEFT: how adaptation subspaces can be shared across layers, and how adaptation capacity can be distributed across matrices.
blocks.zh: 这项工作通过调整FCCA的语音基础模型,调查任务信息化的PEFT是否有效地向多语种低资源ASR转移. 最初的FCCA研究侧重于解码器唯一的自动递归LLMs(即Quen2.5-3B-Instruct [20]),而Whisper等语音模型则使用编码器–解码器架构,必须首先从连续的声学输入中学习表达. 这些差异使得人们不清楚同样基于任务知情的子空间构造是否会在语音识别上表现类似. 在公平竞争论坛的基础上,我们提出了两个补充性办法,以改进基于任务的适应。 非对称-耦合FCCA(AC-FCCA)调查结构化的跨层参数共享是否能提高适应效率,而适应-Rank FCCA(AR-FCCA)则在固定参数预算下在预测矩阵中重新分配适应能力. 这两种方法调查了任务信息灵通的PEFT的不同方面:如何分层共享适应子空间,以及如何在矩阵中分配适应能力。

blocks.en:
In this work, we evaluate the proposed methods on low-resource ASR across multiple languages using Whisper and Qwen3-ASR, chosen to cover different model architectures and their strong performance on multilingual ASR. Experimental results demonstrate that AR-FCCA consistently improves standard FCCA across diverse multilingual benchmarks while remaining competitive with strong PEFT baselines. The main contributions of this work are:
(1) the first systematic investigation of task-informed PEFT (i.e. FCCA) for multilingual low-resource ASR;
(2) proposing two complementary approaches, AC-FCCA and AR-FCCA, extending FCCA through complementary cross-layer sharing and adaptive-rank allocation strategies; and
(3) extensive experiments across multiple languages and two speech foundation models.

blocks.en: 2 Proposed Methods
blocks.zh: 2 拟议方法

blocks.en: Ultra-low-parameter PEFT is attractive because it reduces trainable and optimiser-state memory, but at such small budgets the quality of the chosen update subspace becomes critical. Several LoRA variants use task-dependent statistics to improve the initial adaptation subspace. LoRA-GA [ 22 ] uses downstream gradients, EVA [ 15 ] uses activation statistics, and CorDA [ 23 ] uses task-conditioned activation covariance to orient a decomposition of the pretrained weights, among other approaches [ 9 , 4 , 10 ] . However, these retain LoRA-sized trainable factors. FCCA [ 24 ] instead fixes task-informed left and right bases and trains only a small core matrix, yielding a substantially smaller adaptation budget. We first review FCCA and then introduce two complementary extensions: AC-FCCA for structured cross-layer sharing and AR-FCCA for adaptive rank allocation.
blocks.zh: 超低参数 PEFT具有吸引力,因为它减少了可训练性和可选择状态的内存,但在如此小的预算中,所选更新子空间的质量变得至关重要. 多个LORA变体使用任务依赖的统计来改进初始适应子空间. LoRA-GA [22] 使用下游梯度,EVA [15]使用激活统计,CORDA [23]使用任务附带条件的激活共变,以引导预受训练重量的分解,以及其他方法 [9,4,10]. 然而,这些保留了LORA规模的可培训因素。 FCCA [24] 转而只修补一个小的核心基团,以任务为主的左右基团和列车,产生大幅降低的适应预算. 我们首先审查FCCA,然后引入两个互补的扩展:AC-FCCA用于结构化的跨层共享,AR-FCCA用于适应性等级分配.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. Experiments use five FLEURS languages [ 2 ] , spanning low-resource targets and better-represented multilingual controls. Asturian, Sorani Kurdish, and Kyrgyz form the primary low-resource evaluation, while Mandarin and Persian test whether the observed behaviour extends to better-represented languages. For Whisper, unseen languages use tokens from closely related languages. All adaptation uses only the target-language FLEURS training split (7.5–10.5 h), with hyperparameters selected on validation and final results reported on the held-out test set.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 实验使用五种FLEURS语言[2],跨越了低资源目标以及代表性更好的多语种控制. 阿斯图里安语,索拉尼库尔德语和吉尔吉斯语构成初级低资源评价,而普通话和波斯语则测试所观察到的行为是否扩展到了代表性较高的语言. 对于Whisper,隐形语言使用来自密切相关语言的符号. 所有适应都只使用目标语言FLEURS培训分数(7.5–10.5 h),在验证上选择了超参数,在搁置测试中报告了最后结果。

blocks.en: Table 1 : FLEURS dataset statistics (hours) for target languages.
blocks.zh: 表1:目标语言FLEURS数据集统计(小时).

blocks.en: Models. Experiments use Whisper medium [ 18 ] and Qwen3-ASR-1.7B [ 19 ] . Whisper medium is a 769M-parameter encoder–decoder model with cross-attention, whereas Qwen3-ASR combines an audio encoder with an autoregressive LLM-style decoder. Whisper is evaluated on all five languages; Qwen3-ASR provides cross-model validation on Asturian and Sorani Kurdish, neither of which is among its supported languages.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 实验使用Whisper介质[18]和Quen3-ASR-1.7B [19]. Whisper介质是769M参数的编码器–解码器模型,具有交叉意向,而Quen3-ASR则将音频编码器与自递式LLM型解码器结合. Whisper在全部五种语言上都得到评价;Qune3-ASR在阿斯图里安语和索拉尼库尔德语上提供跨模型验证,两者都不是其支持的语言.

blocks.en:
Baselines and compared approaches. The following methods are used as baselines in the experiments: Vanilla , using the pretrained model directly without any fine-tuning; full fine-tuning (FFT) , updating all model parameters; LoRA [ 6 ] , a widely-used PEFT baseline.
These are compared with standard FCCA [ 24 ] and the proposed AC-FCCA and AR-FCCA variants.
blocks.zh:
基线和比较办法。 以下方法作为实验中的基线: 香草(Vanilla),直接使用经过预先训练的模型而无需任何微调; 完全微调(FFT),更新所有模型参数; LoRA [6],广泛使用的PEFT基线.
与标准FCCA[24]和拟议的AC-FCCA和AR-FCCA的变体进行了比较。

blocks.en: Adaptation Configurations. For Whisper, LoRA and FCCA-based methods adapt the q / k / v / o q/k/v/o projections in encoder self-attention, decoder self-attention, and decoder cross-attention (288 matrices); for Qwen3-ASR, the corresponding audio-encoder and text-decoder projections are adapted (208 matrices). FCCA and its variants use 256 calibration examples sampled from the training set with the same seed, and base rank r = 128 r=128 , training 0.61% and 0.20% of Whisper-medium and Qwen3-ASR parameters, respectively. Calibration is a one-off cost, requiring approximately 20, 40, 90, and 28 s for FCCA, AC-FCCA-H, AC-FCCA-SP, and AR-FCCA, respectively, on an RTX 6000 GPU.
blocks.zh: 适应配置. 对于Whisper,LORA和FCCA基方法,在编码器自留,解码器自留,解码器自留,解码器互留(288个矩阵)中调整q / k / v / o q / k/ k/v/o 的预测;对于Qun3-ASR,相应的音频编码器和文本解码器的预测被调整(208个矩阵). FCCA及其变种使用从具有相同种子的训练集中抽取的256个校准实例,基础等级r = 128 r = 128,训练的Whisper-medic参数分别为0.61%和0.20% Qune3-ASR参数. 校准费用是一次性费用,FCCA、AC-FCCA-H、AC-FCCA-SP和AR-FCCA分别需要大约20、40、90和28s的RTX 6000 GPU。

blocks.en: Training Configuration. Hyperparameters are selected by a small sequential validation-set search. For Whisper-medium, FFT searches learning rates in [ 4 , 7 ] × 10 − 5 [4,7]\times 10^{-5} with effective batch size (EBS) 32, LoRA in [ 1 , 4 ] × 10 − 4 [1,4]\times 10^{-4} with EBS 32, and FCCA in [ 1 , 15 ] × 10 − 4 [1,15]\times 10^{-4} with EBS 8. FCCA uses r = 128 r=128 , while LoRA uses r = 128 r=128 , r = 8 r=8 , and r = 6 r=6 . All systems use AdamW, weight decay 0.01, linear warm-up ratio 0.05, gradient clipping at 1.0, bf16 precision, and at most 12 epochs with early stopping. After selecting the best standard FCCA configuration, its optimisation hyperparameters are reused unchanged for AC-FCCA-H, AC-FCCA-SP, and AR-FCCA, avoiding variant-specific tuning.
blocks.zh: 培训配置。 超参数是通过一个小的顺序验证集搜索来选择的. 对于Whisper-medic,FFT搜索学习率在[4,7]x10−5 [4,7]\times 10−5],有效批量大小(EBS)32,LORA在[1,4]x10−4 [1,4]\times 10^{-4}与EBS 32,FCCA在[1,15]×10−4 [1,15]\times 10^{-4}与EBS 8. FCCA使用r=128 r=128,而LORA使用r=128 r=128,r=8 r=8,r=6 r=6. 所有系统都使用亚当W,重量衰减0.01,线性热速率0.05,梯度剪切精度为1.0,bf16,并且最多有12个早停的纪元. 在选择了最佳标准的FCCA配置后,其优化超参数对AC-FCCA-H,AC-FCCA-SP和AR-FCCA的再使用不变,避免了变异特定的调值.

blocks.en: Decoding Configuration. All systems use deterministic greedy decoding (beam size 1) without an external language model. The target language and transcription task are specified at inference, and the repetition guard described below is applied during generation.
blocks.zh: 解码配置 。 所有系统都使用确定性的贪婪解码(波束尺寸1),没有外部语言模型. 目标语言和抄录任务在推论中被指定,以下描述的重复守备在生成时被应用.

blocks.en: Post-processing and Evaluation. Before scoring, references and hypotheses undergo NFKC normalization [ 21 ] , case-folding, punctuation/symbol and control-character removal, Unicode-digit canonicalization, and whitespace collapse. Persian additionally canonicalizes Arabic-script variants for evaluation. Mandarin hypotheses are converted from Traditional to Simplified Chinese with OpenCC [ 14 ] ; whitespace is then removed from references and hypotheses before CER computation. We report CER for Mandarin and WER for all other languages. To suppress decoding hallucinations, generation terminates when any token cycle of length 1–8 repeats six consecutive times.
blocks.zh: 后处理和评价。 评分前,引用和假设经历NFKC正常化[21],大小写文件夹,标点/符号和控制字符删除,Unicode-digital cononication,以及白空间崩溃. 波斯语另外将阿拉伯语的标语变体用于评价. 普通话假说由传统汉语转换为简化汉语,使用OpenCC [14];然后在CER计算前从参考文献和假说中删除白空. 我们报告普通话的CER和所有其他语言的WER. 为了抑制解码幻觉,当任何1~8的符号循环连续6次重复时,生成终止.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Whisper Baseline Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1 低调基线性能

blocks.en:
We first present the baseline experiments on Whisper under different adaptation strategies. As shown in Table 2 , Vanilla Whisper shows low CER on Mandarin and reasonable WER on Persian, both of which are supported languages in Whisper, but degrades substantially on unsupported languages. This contrast highlights the difficulty of recognising languages with limited pre-training support.
Full fine-tuning provides the strongest conventional adaptation baseline across most languages. On Mandarin, however, Vanilla Whisper already achieves 8.88% CER, leaving limited room for improvement with fewer than 10 hours of training data. LoRA with rank 128 (LoRA-128) approaches FFT while updating substantially fewer parameters. To separate the effect of adaptation strategy from trainable-parameter budget, we additionally include rank-8 LoRA (LoRA-8), which has a parameter budget comparable to the FCCA-based methods. Compared to LoRA-128, LoRA-8 performs 2–8% WER worse, which is expected given its smaller update space.
blocks.zh:
我们首先介绍不同适应战略下的Whisper基准试验。 如表2所示,Vanilla Whisper在普通话上显示的CER低,在波斯语上显示的合理WER,这两种语言都是Whisper语的支持语言,但在不支持的语言上却大幅降解. 这种对比凸显了在培训前支助有限的情况下很难识别语言。
全面微调为大多数语言提供了最强的传统适应基线。 然而,在普通话上,香草Whisper已经实现了8.88%的CER,在不到10小时的培训数据的情况下,留有有限的改进空间. 排名128的LORA(LORA-128)接近FFT,同时更新的参数少得多. 为了将适应战略的影响与可培训参数预算区分开来,我们还列入了第8级LORA(LORA-8),后者的参数预算与FCCA方法相当。 与LORA-128相比,LORA-8执行的WER更差2~8%,考虑到更新空间较小,预计会更差.

blocks.en: 4.2 Task-informed PEFT - FCCA variants
blocks.zh: 4.2 任务信息PEFT - FCCA变体

blocks.en:
Here, we investigate the performance of standard FCCA (Section 2.1 ) and proposed FCCA variants (Section 2.2 and 2.3 ) on Whisper.
We use rank 128 for FCCA to match the rank of LoRA-128, which provides performance close to FFT while remaining parameter efficient. Owing to the frozen-core formulation, rank-128 FCCA trains only 0.61% of Whisper parameters, giving a trainable-parameter budget comparable to LoRA-8. This allows two complementary comparisons: LoRA-128 provides a rank-matched baseline, while LoRA-8 provides a parameter-matched baseline.
blocks.zh:
在此,我们调查标准FCCA(第2.1节)的性能,并提议FCCA(第2.2和2.3节)关于Whisper的变体。
我们使用128级FCCA来匹配LORA-128的军衔,后者在保持参数效率的同时提供接近FFFT的性能. 由于冷冻核心配方,一级-128 FCCA列车只有0.61%的Whisper参数,使得可列车参数预算与LORA-8相当. 这使得可以进行两个互补的比较:LORA-128提供了排序匹配的基准,而LORA-8提供了参数匹配的基准.

blocks.en: FCCA trains 16 times fewer parameters than LoRA-128 and yields WER 0.36–7.14 percentage points higher than LoRA-128. Moreover, under the parameter-matched comparison, FCCA outperforms LoRA-8 on 3 languages in Whisper and almost matches it in others, suggesting that task-informed subspace construction is more effective than the budget-matched standard LoRA method. FCCA and all FCCA variants on Asturian and Kyrgyz, as well as AC-FCCA-H and AR-FCCA on Mandarin, give significant results at p < 0.05 p<0.05 under MAPSSWE against LoRA-8.
blocks.zh: FCCA列车的参数比LORA-128少16倍,并且比LORA-128高0.36–7.14个百分点. 此外,在参数匹配的比较下,FCCA在Whisper3种语言上的LORA-8表现优于其他语言的LORA-8,几乎与之相匹配,说明任务知情的子空间构建比预算匹配的标准LORA方法更有效. FCCA和关于阿斯图里亚语和吉尔吉斯语的所有FCCA变体,以及关于普通话的AC-FCCA-H和AR-FCCA,在MAPSSWE下对LORA-8在p < 0.05 p < 0.05中取得了显著成果。

blocks.en: The AC-FCCA variants introduce structured cross-layer sharing on top of standard FCCA. They outperform FCCA across four of the five Whisper languages and AC-FCCA-H yields significant results at p < 0.05 p<0.05 under MAPSSWE on two languages, improving WER from 44.97% to 44.35% on Sorani Kurdish and CER from 10.46% to 10.19% on Mandarin. Our preliminary analysis had shown that both AC-FCCA constructions achieved higher Fisher-weighted gradient capture than standard FCCA on a disjoint probe set, suggesting improved preservation of task-relevant update structure.
blocks.zh: AC-FCCA变体在标准FCCA之上引入结构化的跨层共享. 在两种语言的MAPSSWE下,这些语言在四种Whisper语言和AC-FCCA-H上的成绩都超过了FCCA,在两种语言的MAPSSWE下得出了0.05 p < 0.05,在Sorani库尔德语上WER从44.97%提高到44.35%,在普通话上CER从10.46%提高到10.19%。 我们的初步分析表明,两个AC-FCCA构造在离合探测器集上实现了比标准FCCA更高的费舍加权梯度捕获,建议更好地保存与任务有关的更新结构。

blocks.en: AR-FCCA gives the most consistent improvement over standard FCCA; it reduces WER by 0.32–1.13 percentage points across all languages and achieves statistically significant gains at p < 0.05 p<0.05 under MAPSSWE over standard FCCA on Sorani Kurdish and Mandarin. The improvements are observed across both unsupported and supported languages, showing that adaptive rank allocation provides a robust extension to standard FCCA without increasing the overall parameter budget.
blocks.zh: 与标准FCCA相比,AR-FCCA得到了最一致的改进;它在所有语言中将WER降低了0.32-1.13个百分点,并在MAPSSWE下在统计学上比标准FCCA在索拉尼库尔德语和普通话上取得了显著的增益 < 0.05 p<0.05。 在不支持和不支持的语言中都观察到这些改进,表明适应性级别分配在不增加总参数预算的情况下能够有力地扩展至标准FCCA。

blocks.en: Table 2 : WER (%) on FLEURS test sets using Whisper medium; CER (%) for Mandarin.
blocks.zh: 表2:使用Whisper介质的FLEURS测试机组的WER(%);普通话的CER(%).

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization to Qwen3-ASR
blocks.zh: 4.3 一般化为Qwen3-ASR

blocks.en: This subsection investigates whether the observations on Whisper generalize to a structurally different speech foundation model. Qwen3-ASR is evaluated on Asturian and Sorani Kurdish, both of which are unsupported by the pretrained model. As shown in Table 3 , Vanilla Qwen3-ASR performs poorly on both languages, with WERs of 48.94% and 105.30%, respectively. As with Whisper, FFT and LoRA-128 give largest improvement on WER; for Asturian, FFT and LoRA are almost matched at 16.06% and 16.05%.
blocks.zh: 本小节调查关于Whisper的观察是否概括为结构上不同的语音基础模型. Qune3-ASR在阿斯图里安和索拉尼库尔德语上得到评价,两者都没有得到预先训练过的模型的支持. 如表3所示,Vanilla Qune3-ASR在两种语言上表现不佳,WERs分别为48.94%和105.30%. 同Whisper一样,FFT和LORA-128对WER作了最大的改进;对Asturian来说,FFT和LORA几乎是16.06%和16.05%。

blocks.en: Standard FCCA substantially improves the pretrained model, reducing WER to 19.61% on Asturian and 44.22% on Sorani, but as with Whisper, it still trails the rank-matched LoRA-128. FCCA also beats its trainable-parameter-matched LoRA version (LoRA-6) by 0.17% WER on Asturian and 0.77% on Sorani Kuridish. However, the AC-FCCA variants which offered improvements on FCCA in Whisper, increase WER in Qwen3-ASR. In contrast, AR-FCCA again gives the strongest FCCA-based performance, reducing WER further to 18.56% and 42.98%, respectively. These improvements over standard FCCA are statistically significant for both Asturian ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ) and Sorani ( p = 0.05 p=0.05 ) under MAPSSWE.
blocks.zh: 标准FCCA大幅改进了预训型号,将WER在阿斯图里安的比分降至19.61%,在索拉尼的比分降至44.22%,但和Whisper一样,它仍然跟随排名相当的LORA-128. FCCA还以0.17%的WER在阿斯图里安和0.77%在索拉尼库里迪什比对其可训练参数匹配的LORA版本(LORA-6). 然而,在Whisper为FCCA提供了改进的AC-FCCA变体,在Qune3-ASR中增加了WER. 相比之下,AR-FCCA再次给出了最强的基于FCCA的性能,将WER分别进一步降至18.56%和42.98%. 在MAPSSWE下,这些与标准FCCA相比的改进对于阿斯图里亚语(p = 0.001 p = 0.001)和索拉尼语(p = 0.05 p = 0.05)都具有统计意义.

blocks.en: Table 3 : WER (%) on FLEURS test sets using Qwen3-ASR-1.7B.

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis of Adaptive Rank Allocation
blocks.zh: 4.4 调整等级分配分析

blocks.en: The consistent gains from AR-FCCA across Whisper and Qwen3-ASR motivate a closer examination of this approach. Figure 1 shows the rank allocation for Whisper on Asturian. Rank allocation patterns are highly consistent across languages within each model. AR-FCCA jointly chooses per-matrix ranks to maximize retained Fisher-whitened spectral energy under a fixed global budget, so larger ranks are assigned where adding further directions continues to capture substantial task-relevant spectral energy. In Whisper, this concentrates rank in decoder output projections, while Qwen3-ASR assigns high ranks to q / o q/o in the text tower but to v / k v/k in the audio tower, with audio rank also tending to increase with depth.
blocks.zh: 在整个Whisper和Qune3-ASR中,AR-FCCA不断取得收益,促使人们更仔细地审查这一办法。 图1显示阿斯图里安Whisper的军衔分配. 每个模式内各语文的排名分配模式高度一致。 AR-FCCA联合选择了每个矩阵的排名,以在固定的全球预算下最大限度地保留费舍尔-白光谱能量,因此在增加方向后继续捕捉与任务相关的大量光谱能量的地方分配了更大的排名. 在Whisper中,这种集中在解码器输出预测中排位,而Qune3-ASR则在文本塔中指派高阶的q / o q/o,但在音响塔中则指定v / k v/k,音频的排位也倾向于随着深度而增加.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This work investigated task-informed PEFT for multilingual low-resource ASR through FCCA and two complementary extensions. Across Whisper and Qwen3-ASR, standard FCCA provided a highly parameter-efficient alternative to conventional PEFT with matched parameter budget, while the AC-FCCA variants gave only limited additional gains. AR-FCCA provided the most consistent improvements over standard FCCA by reallocating the same trainable budget across projection matrices, with gains observed across both speech foundation models and multiple languages and statistically significant improvements in several settings. Further analysis showed that AR-FCCA assigns markedly different ranks across layers and projections, and that these allocations retain higher FCCA spectral utility than uniform rank allocation throughout training. A limitation is the lack of systematic parameter-matched LoRA comparisons such as LoRA-XS, which we leave for future work.
blocks.zh: 这项工作调查了多语种低资源ASR和两个补充扩展的PEFT的任务信息。 在整个Whisper和Qune3-ASR中,标准FCCA为常规PEFT提供了具有高度参数效率的替代品,并配有相应的参数预算,而AC-FCCA的变体只提供了有限的额外收益. 与标准FCCA相比,AR-FCCA提供了最一致的改进,在预测矩阵中重新分配了同样的可培训预算,在语音基础模型和多种语言中都观察到了成果,在统计学上在几个背景下也有重大改进。 进一步的分析表明,非洲竞争和消费者保护论坛分层和预测的级别明显不同,这些分配比整个培训中统一的级别分配保持更高的FCCA光谱效用。 一个限制因素是缺乏诸如LORA-XS等系统参数匹配的LORA比较,我们留待今后工作。
